name: Loki
source:
Friend or Foe?
A young man who is shrouded in mystery. Another mahoutsukai, by the name [url=https://vndb.org/c6288]Yoshino Reiji[/url], was once referred to as "Loki". However, this Loki's appearance gives of a more confident and refined aura around him compared to Reiji. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=776568]Getchu[/url]]
